description: I'm an AI & Data Science student and software developer passionate about AI/ML, space technology, computer vision, and full-stack development. I have experience building AI-powered applications and working with large datasets. My team earned the Best Use of Science Award at NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025 for an AI-powered Exoplanet Observatory. I'm participating with a friend, aiming to build innovative, scientifically meaningful solutions to real-world challenges.
